svg.aria-label: Boyi Dai, Computer Engineering at UVA. Interested in systems, infrastructure and compilers. Built from scratch: an LLM inference engine, a tensor compiler, a SQL engine, an 8-bit CPU. Currently building nanocompile, a tensor compiler for nanoinfer, phase 3 of 8.
